summary.en: Doubao Work (豆包工作) as a magpie provider with long-context attachment upload: sign in by pasting a cookie, from a one-off browser window, or from the desktop client. Every model in the account's menu shows up with its real billing rate. Prompts exceeding 262K chars are automatically uploaded as attachments, so Qoder and other agents with large tool schemas work without hitting the upstream limit.
summary.zh: 豆包工作 magpie 供应商插件，支持超长上下文附件上传：粘贴 Cookie、临时浏览器窗口或桌面客户端三种登录方式。超过 262K 字符的 prompt 自动走附件上传，Qoder 等携带大量工具 Schema 的 Agent 可正常使用。账号菜单全部模型均可用，显示真实扣费倍率、积分与签到状态。
